text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Personal Photos Photo requirements: color standard photos, the size is not more than 200kb, support *.jpg, *.jpeg, *.png as the suffix of the picture, pixels greater than 295 * 413. * 2. ID photo(white background) Taken within the last 3 months. * 3. Passport Information Page The validity period must be later than September 1, 2027 If the applicant is currently in China, both the current visa page and the most recent entry stamp page must be provided 4. Other academic support documents (such as award certificates, other university admission notices, etc.); * 5. Non-Chinese native speakers need to provide Chinese proficiency proof (exempted with HSK 4 or above). * 6. Highest degree certificate or expected graduation proof (original): (1) Graduating high school students submit proof of expected high school graduation (issued by the high school issuing the graduation certificate); (2) Graduated high school students submit the high school graduation certificate; (3) Curent university students, in addition to the high school graduation certificate, also need to provide a curent enrollment certificate from their university. (4) Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 7. Oficial transcripts from the highest degree-granting institution (original) Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 8. Certificate of no criminal record * 9. Personal Statement Including self-introduction, educational experiences and study plan. * 10. Economic Proof(bank balance or certificate） Bank deposits should be more thanRMB 20,000, should be issued within the last 2 months. * 11. Foreigner's physical examination certificate * 12. Other materials I) Product Design Required materials: at least 6 representative works The content must include: 1. Structural sketch 2. Creative colors 3. Effect drawings of product design works (Scope: Furniture, crafts, home appliances, jewelry design, etc. Include structural design drawings for better results) (II) Visual Communication Design Required materials: at least 10 representative works The content must include (but is not limited to): 1. Sketch 2. Colour 3. Advertisement project 4. Brand image design 5. Digital media design Note: Upon enrollment, the School of Fine Arts and Design will administer a professional competency test for 2026 international undergraduate students. If the test performance does not match the submitted application materials, or if plagiarism or falsification is detected, the school will initiate the expulsion process. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
